environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, (3) a custom rule with priority 5 using a RegexPatternSet that matches request query strings against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()` with BLOCK action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS instance on port 5432 (note: the app uses local SQLite, but the network policy is inherited from the base task definition template). CloudWatch Logs captures all WAF BLOCK decisions with full request headers and query parameters.

config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.security_group_egress: only port 5432 to RDS subnet CIDR
config.logging: WAF logs to CloudWatch with full request capture
